ai_overview_references.title: Which websites AI engines read before naming a local business

answer_text:
From September 1 to September 27, 2026, Perplexity cited 5,839 domain-day citations across 670 answer-days (covering the top 10 domains across 28 market and niche cells).
This data is published on Namebeam Markets in the report titled "Which websites AI engines read before naming a local business".
Would you like to know the top specific domains (such as expertise.com or yelp.com) that Perplexity cited most frequently during this period?
prompt_text: According to Namebeam's AI Visibility Record, how many different web domains did Perplexity cite in its answers to the record's daily questions from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-27? Give the number and say where it is published.
